Name: (AT) Too Many Swatches II
Author: orangeblossom7
Description:
[font=Georgia][center][size=4]Too Many Swatches II﻿[/size]
[size=2]by orangeblossom[/size][i][size=1]﻿[/size][/i][/center][size=2]
I got so annoyed by the amount of swatches in the first version of this mod and that's why I created a new one with lesser (there's still a handful) swatches. I reduced the number of wood tones to five and I also added a few improvements.[/size]

[color=#ffe599][u][size=5]May 9, 2024 notes:[/size][/u]
[/color][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffe599]You can find the matching wallpaper and flooring here:[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23819]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23819[/url]﻿ [/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffe599]I made it this way to remove the red errors from SMAPI (which usually shows up if you're on SDV 1.6) because I added the walls and floors using content patcher. [/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffe599]If you don't mind the red errors (i'm on 1.6 and it's still usable for me so i don't really mind), you can just ignore this update and keep using version 1.4.1 of this mod. :DD[/color][/font]
[/list]
